name: Loaning Money To People
overview: Scripture instructs believers to lend money to those in need without charging interest, especially to fellow Israelites who are poor or struggling, emphasizing mercy and generosity rather than profit (Exodus 22:25; Deuteronomy 23:19-20). The Lord calls His people to open their hands and hearts to their brothers in need, ensuring their well-being and reflecting God's blessing (Deuteronomy 15:7; Leviticus 25:35). Those who refrain from exploiting others through usury and act justly are promised stability and divine favor (Psalms 15:5).
